name: Byrna Technologies Inc.
summary:
Byrna Technologies (BYRN) reported a loss of $0.13 per share on revenue of $15.30 million for the fiscal third quarter ended August 2026. The consensus estimate was a loss of $0.15 per share on revenue of $16.04 million. The Earnings Whisper number was a loss of $0.18 per share. The company beat expectations by 27.78% while revenue fell 45.72% compared to the same quarter a year ago.

Byrna is a technology company, specializing in the development, manufacture, and sale of innovative non-lethal personal protection solutions.
subject: Byrna Technologies Beat Expectations

name: Tilray Brands, Inc.
summary:
Tilray Brands (TLRY) reported a loss of $0.32 per share on revenue of $257.15 million for the fiscal first quarter ended August 2026. The consensus estimate was a loss of $0.19 per share on revenue of $264.90 million. The company missed consensus estimates by 68.42%.

The company said it continues to expect Adjusted EBITDA of $68.0 million to $75.0 million for the year ending May 31, 2027.

Tilray Brands, Inc. is a leading global lifestyle and consumer packaged goods company with operations in Canada, the United States, Europe, Australia, and Latin America that is leading as a transformative force at the nexus of cannabis, beverage, wellness, and entertainment, elevating lives through moments of connection.
subject: Tilray Brands Missed Consensus Estimates, Reaffirms

name: Helen of Troy Ltd.
summary:
Helen of Troy (HELE) reported earnings of $0.79 per share on revenue of $440.93 million for the fiscal second quarter ended August 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $0.51 per share on revenue of $441.45 million. The Earnings Whisper number was $0.55 per share. The company beat expectations by 43.64% while revenue grew 2.12% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it now expects fiscal 2027 non-GAAP earnings of $3.60 to $4.15 per share on revenue of $1.768 billion to $1.822 billion. The company's previous guidance was non-GAAP earnings of $3.25 to $3.75 per share on revenue of $1.759 billion to $1.831 billion. The current consensus earnings estimate is $3.54 per share on revenue of $1.810 billion for the year ending February 28, 2027.

Helen of Troy Limited is a leading global consumer products company offering creative solutions for its customers through a diversified portfolio of well-recognized and widely-trusted brands, including OXO, Hydro Flask, Vicks, Braun, Honeywell, PUR, Hot Tools, and Drybar.
subject: Helen of Troy Beat Expectations, Raises Guidance

name: AngioDynamics
summary:

AngioDynamics Inc designs, manufactures and sells medical, surgical and diagnostic devices used by professional healthcare providers for vascular access, for the treatment of peripheral vascular disease and for use in oncology and surgical settings.
subject: AngioDynamics Beat Expectations, Reaffirms

name: PepsiCo, Inc.
summary:
PepsiCo (PEP) reported earnings of $2.34 per share on revenue of $25.27 billion for the third quarter ended September 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $2.29 per share on revenue of $24.88 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $2.32 per share. The company beat expectations by 0.86% while revenue grew 5.59% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it now expects 2026 earnings of $8.34 to $8.42 per share on revenue of approximately $99.56 billion. The company's previous guidance was earnings of $8.55 to $8.71 per share on revenue of $97.68 billion to $99.56 billion, and the current consensus earnings estimate is $8.56 per share on revenue of $98.86 billion for the year ending December 31, 2026.

PepsiCo products are enjoyed by consumers more than one billion times a day in more than 200 countries and territories around the world.
subject: PepsiCo Beat Expectations, Provides Mixed Guidance
